title: Grateful Dead Live at Zoo Amphitheatre on 1982-08-01
lineage: 2nd GEN Cassettes > Nakamichi Cassette Deck 2 (azimuth adjusted) > Kind Kables RCA/XLR > Lunatec V3 (@24 bit 96 kHz) > coax > Audiophile 2496 > WaveLab 5.0 > 24 bit WAV > Waves L3 UltraMaximizer(dither) > 16 bit WAV > CD Wave Editor > TLH > FLAC16
source: (FOB) Nakamichi CM-700s > Sony TC-D5M > MC > Cassette x2

ai_review.summary: Fair audience cassette capture of a scorching Oklahoma show, highlighted by an impressive second set with the classic Playin' > Iko transition and a smooth "The Wheel" performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience tape passed through several cassette generations with Dolby noise reduction, which gives it noticeable hiss and occasional drop‑outs but still preserves the concert’s spirit. Musically the show shines in the second set – the seamless Playin' > Iko segue, a standout "The Wheel", and energetic moments keep fans engaged despite the oppressive heat that dulled parts of the first set.

ai_rating.rationale: Show performance is generally praised (especially the second set) while the tape‑generation recording quality detracts, leading to a combined rating near four stars with moderate confidence due to mixed comments.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple cassette generations with Dolby noise reduction introduce hiss and occasional drop‑outs; overall listenable but not as clear as a soundboard or SBD source.

poor_songs: Lost Sailor / Saint of Circumstance (noted as indecisive)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set hampered by heat, but second set picks up momentum with a smooth Playin' > Iko segue and a strong "The Wheel" closing.
